notes:
OSF file fr6g8 is the primary SCORE replication report and its title/project ID matches the supplied reference, despite the input citation date differing from the OSF file upload date (2020). Extracted final pooled Stage 2 rather than interim Stage 1. Kept printed log odds ratio and its accompanying Wald p = 0.240 together; the report separately prints a chi-square test with p = 0.239 on p. 5. Original DOI landing page was restricted-access abstract only; Unpaywall and OpenAlex identified the same SSRN accepted manuscript, but SSRN returned 403 and was not retried. Publisher supplemental route also returned 403/challenge. No original statistics were inferred from replication quotations.
Source follow-up: Original-only blind extraction. Published 2011 article title/authors visually verified on PDF page 1; target methods and results visually verified on PDF pages 6–7 (printed pp. 408–409). The page-7 locator uniquely identifies the Study 3 dessert-choice comparison; Study 4 only begins on that page. Requested log_odds_ratio is not printed for this test; retained the printed chi-square statistic without conversion. Canonical text renders the printed Greek chi-square glyph as c2; rendered PDF confirms chi-square with df=1 and N=36, statistic 5.46 and p < .03. Quote preserves canonical OCR c2 and uses an explicit ellipsis to omit interleaved right-column text. N is established by the target test, not merely the recruited total. Replication and reported_success placeholders are unassigned, not acquisition failures.
